title: Area, Perimeter and Fractions Unit Test
subject: math

items.prompt: An L-shape is made of part A, 200 by 120, and part B, 120 by 140. Find the total area of the L. Show your working.

points.text: Finds part A as 200 x 120 = 24 000 and part B as 120 x 140 = 16 800
Adds the parts to get the total area of 40 800

items.prompt: Explain why the area of the L-shape is not 200 x 260, using the empty corner.

points.text: States that the 200 by 260 bounding box includes an empty corner that is not part of the L
Concludes only the filled parts count, so the area is 24 000 + 16 800 = 40 800, not 52 000

items.prompt: A baker uses 3/4 kg of flour in the morning and 1/4 kg in the afternoon. How much flour is used in total?

levels.label: Secure
levels.descriptor: Working is complete, ordered and uses correct area, perimeter and fraction notation throughout.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Working is partial or notation is inconsistent, but the method can be followed.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: Little or no working shown; the method cannot be followed.
